newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs down on fear of growth, Bund head & shoulder.
newsitem.headline: OLOs down on fear of growth, Bund head & shoulder.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds opened lower with Bunds, hit by lower Treasuries, negative sentiment, and fears that economic growth in Europe will break the two-year old uptrend.

Linear bond front month futures were down 19 bp at 120.38, Bund futures down 18 bp at 100.75. Chartists pointed at the possibility that the Bund contract is in the process of forming a large head-and-shoulder formation, with the left shoulder in November-December, the head in February-March, and the right shoulder now being formed. Head-and-shoulders are seen as powerful warning signs of trend changes.
